findings.description: The EASY, HARD and CHAOS runtimes (campaign22/23/24) were launched with '-Dachievetodo.progression.freshConfig=true' in addition to the two -javaagent entries, contradicting the brief's certified operator launch (no -Dachievetodo.* flags). The plugin itself (ReleaseLaunchProfile.java:26,85) would derive freshConfig only on the start that writes the world group, so these three runtimes did not exercise the pure release derivation; their threshold rows were not produced under the certified composition. campaign21 and campaign25 are clean.

ATD_STAGE2A_STATE carries no lock state for ATTACK_WITH_MACE (shown as null), so the tested ability's lock state is not visible in the server log and is inferred from count vs threshold plus the client overlay.

The locked excerpts of attack_with_mace contain no server-side plugin decision line (no attack packet, no ATD_EVENT and no denial line; only the unchanged pig health); the denial is visible only through the client overlay recorded in rows.jsonl and the missing effect. The verdict is consistent but rests on client data, not on the raw server lines.
